FormConditionalActionDto.description: Data Transfer Object representing an action to be performed when conditional rule criteria are met. Actions can modify field properties, visibility, validation rules, or perform calculations based on form state.

targetName.description: Name of the field or section that this action will target. Must match exactly with an existing field name or section identifier in the form. This determines which form element will be affected when the action executes.

actionType.description: Type of action to perform on the target field or section. Determines the specific behavior that will be executed when the conditional rule triggers.

actionValue.description: Value to use for the action, when applicable. The meaning depends on the action type: â€¢ For SET_VALUE: the value to assign to the field â€¢ For SET_DEFAULT_VALUE: the default value to set â€¢ For ADD_CSS_CLASS/REMOVE_CSS_CLASS: the CSS class name â€¢ For SET_VALIDATION_PATTERN: the regex pattern â€¢ For SET_HELP_TEXT/SET_PLACEHOLDER: the text content â€¢ For COPY_VALUE_FROM: the source field name â€¢ For CALCULATE_VALUE: the calculation expression â€¢ For SET_MAX_LENGTH/SET_MIN_LENGTH: the numeric length value
actionValue.example: Please provide your full address details

actionParameters.description: Additional parameters for complex actions in key=value format, separated by semicolons. Provides extended configuration options for actions that require multiple parameters. Examples: â€¢ 'duration=500;easing=ease-in' for animation parameters â€¢ 'case_sensitive=false;trim_whitespace=true' for text processing â€¢ 'format=currency;locale=en_US' for value formatting â€¢ 'source_field=country;target_format=uppercase' for value transformation

FormConditionalConditionDto.description: Data Transfer Object representing a condition that evaluates field values against specified criteria. Conditions are the building blocks of conditional logic rules that determine when actions should be triggered based on user input or form state.

sourceFieldName.description: Name of the form field whose value will be evaluated by this condition. Must match exactly with an existing field name in the form. This field's current value will be compared against the specified criteria to determine if the condition is met.

operator.description: Comparison operator that defines how the field value should be evaluated. Different operators support different data types and comparison logic.

comparisonValue.description: Value to compare the field value against. The interpretation depends on the operator: â€¢ Text operators (EQUALS, CONTAINS, etc.): direct string comparison â€¢ Numeric operators (GREATER_THAN, etc.): numeric value for comparison â€¢ List operators (IN_LIST, NOT_IN_LIST): comma-separated values â€¢ Regex operator (MATCHES_REGEX): regular expression pattern â€¢ Length operators: numeric length value â€¢ Empty/checkbox operators: not used, can be null For case-insensitive comparisons, use additionalParameter.

additionalParameter.description: Additional parameter for fine-tuning condition behavior. Common uses: â€¢ 'case_insensitive=true': for case-insensitive text comparisons â€¢ 'trim_whitespace=true': to ignore leading/trailing spaces â€¢ 'delimiter=|': custom delimiter for list operations (default is comma) â€¢ 'regex_flags=i': regex flags for pattern matching â€¢ 'date_format=yyyy-MM-dd': for date comparison formatting â€¢ 'locale=en_US': for locale-specific numeric comparisons

negate.description: Whether to negate (invert) the result of this condition. When true, the condition will trigger when the comparison would normally be false. This provides a convenient way to create 'NOT' logic without changing operators. For example: EQUALS with negate=true becomes 'NOT EQUALS'.

FormConditionalRuleDto.description: Data Transfer Object representing a complete conditional logic rule for dynamic form behavior. Rules combine multiple conditions with logical operators and define actions to execute when criteria are met. This enables sophisticated form interactions like showing/hiding fields, setting values, and modifying validation rules.

name.description: Human-readable name for this conditional rule. Should clearly describe the rule's purpose or behavior for easy identification and maintenance. Used for administrative purposes and debugging.
name.example: Show Address Fields When Country Is Selected

logicalOperator.description: Logical operator used to combine multiple conditions within this rule. Determines how the individual conditions are evaluated together to determine if the rule should trigger.

conditions.description: List of conditions that must be evaluated to determine if this rule should execute. At least one condition is required. Multiple conditions are combined using the logical operator. Each condition evaluates a specific field value against defined criteria.

actions.description: List of actions to perform when the rule conditions are satisfied. At least one action is required. Actions can modify field properties, visibility, values, or validation rules. Multiple actions execute in the order they are defined.

active.description: Whether this rule is currently active and should be evaluated. Inactive rules are ignored during form processing. Useful for temporarily disabling rules without deleting them, or for A/B testing different rule configurations.

priority.description: Execution priority of this rule relative to other rules. Higher priority rules (larger numbers) are evaluated and executed before lower priority rules. Important for managing rule dependencies and ensuring proper execution order when multiple rules might affect the same form elements.

conditionGrouping.description: Advanced condition grouping expression for complex logical combinations. Allows creation of sophisticated condition logic beyond simple AND/OR operations. Format: '1,2|3,4' means (condition1 AND condition2) OR (condition3 AND condition4). Use commas for AND operations and pipes (|) for OR operations. Leave null for simple logical operator behavior. Examples: â€¢ '1,2|3' = (condition1 AND condition2) OR condition3 â€¢ '1|2,3|4' = condition1 OR (condition2 AND condition3) OR condition4

createdDate.description: Timestamp when the entity was created

lastModifiedBy.description: Identifier of the user who last modified the entity

deletedDate.description: Timestamp when the entity was deleted, if applicable

impersonatedBy.description: UUID of the admin who was impersonating when this entity was last modified. Null if the action was performed directly (no impersonation). Used for compliance audit to track which admin performed actions while impersonating another user.

firmId.description: Firm identifier for firm-level isolation within a tenant. Each tenant can have multiple firms, and this field identifies which firm this entity belongs to.

firmName.description: Name of the firm this entity belongs to. This is a computed field populated from the Firm entity via mapper @AfterMapping methods.

tenantName.description: Name of the tenant this entity belongs to. This is a computed field populated from the Tenant entity via mapper @AfterMapping methods.

name.description: Name or title of the form displayed to users and administrators. Should be descriptive and clearly indicate the form's purpose or the type of data it collects.

description.description: Optional detailed description of the form's purpose, intended audience, or usage instructions. Provides additional context for form administrators and can be displayed to users as introductory text.
description.example: Complete this form to begin the customer onboarding process. All required fields must be filled accurately.

sections.description: Ordered list of form sections that structure the form content. Sections provide logical grouping of related fields and can contain subsections for hierarchical organization. The order in this list determines the display sequence in the form interface.

type.description: Classification type of the document or form template. Defines the category and processing rules for this form within the document management system.

documentId.description: Unique identifier of the document template associated with this form. READ-ONLY on this DTO: the Formâ†”Document association is owned by the Document side (@OneToOne(mappedBy="associatedForm")), so PATCH on this field is silently dropped. To set or change the association, call POST /api/v1/form/{formId}/document/{documentId}.

document.description: Complete document object associated with this form, if available. Contains the full document metadata, template information, and file details. READ-ONLY (same inverse-side reason as documentId): the association is owned by the Document and cannot be persisted via a PATCH on Form. Use POST /api/v1/form/{formId}/document/{documentId} to set or change the link.

conditionalRules.description: List of conditional logic rules that control dynamic form behavior. Rules define when and how form elements should change based on user input or form state. Enables sophisticated interactions like showing/hiding fields, setting values, and modifying validation rules.

domains.description: Domain entity types this form pulls data from. Each domain's alias is the path prefix for field value paths.

FormFieldDto.description: Data Transfer Object representing a single form field for data collection. Fields are the fundamental input elements that users interact with to provide information. Supports various field types, validation rules, and integration with PDF documents.

name.description: Name or label of the form field displayed to users. Should be clear and descriptive to help users understand what information is expected. Also serves as the unique identifier for the field within the form.

fieldType.description: Type of input control that determines how users interact with the field. Each type provides different input capabilities and validation behaviors.

associatedText.description: Additional descriptive text or instructions associated with the field. Can provide context, examples, or detailed guidance to help users complete the field correctly.
associatedText.example: Enter your full legal name as it appears on government-issued identification

displayOrder.description: Display order for this field within its parent section or subsection. Used for drag-and-drop reordering in the form builder.

page.description: Page number where this field appears in multi-page forms or documents. Used for organizing complex forms and coordinating with PDF page layouts.

maxLength.description: Maximum number of characters allowed in this field. Enforces input length limits for data validation and storage constraints. Set to 0 for no limit.

minLength.description: Minimum number of characters required in this field. Ensures input meets minimum length requirements for data quality. Set to 0 for no minimum.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text displayed in empty fields to guide user input. Provides hints about the expected format or content without being a default value.

helpText.description: Help text providing additional guidance or context for the field. Can be displayed as tooltips, help bubbles, or explanatory text near the field.
helpText.example: Your name must match exactly what appears on your identification documents

required.description: Whether this field must be completed before the form can be submitted. Required fields are typically marked with visual indicators like asterisks.

readonly.description: Whether this field is read-only and cannot be edited by users. Useful for displaying calculated values, system-generated data, or pre-filled information.

validationPattern.description: Regular expression pattern for validating field input. Enables custom validation rules beyond basic field type validation. Pattern must match the entire field value for validation to pass.

validationMessage.description: Custom error message displayed when field validation fails. Provides user-friendly feedback when input doesn't meet validation requirements.
validationMessage.example: Name must contain only letters and spaces

defaultValue.description: Default value pre-populated in the field when the form loads. Users can modify this value unless the field is read-only.

fieldValue.description: Current value entered or selected in the field. Represents the user's input or system-assigned value for this field.

obtainValueFromPath.description: Object path expression for automatically obtaining field values from data sources. Uses dot notation to navigate object properties (e.g., 'customer.address.zipCode'). Enables dynamic field population from external data.

list.description: Configuration for list-based fields like dropdowns, radio buttons, and checkboxes. Defines the available options and selection behavior for choice-based fields.

pdfField.description: PDF-specific field mapping information for document generation and population. Links this form field to specific locations and properties within PDF documents.

FormFieldListDto.description: Data Transfer Object for form field list configuration used in dropdown menus, radio button groups, checkbox lists, and multi-select fields. Defines the available options and selection behavior for choice-based form fields.

optionsEnum.description: Name of the Java enum class associated with the list options. Provides type-safe option management and enables automatic option generation from enum values. When specified, the system can validate selections against the enum and provide consistent option sets.

allowMultiple.description: Whether users can select multiple options from this list. Controls the field's selection behavior and UI presentation: â€¢ true: Enables checkboxes or multi-select dropdowns for multiple selections â€¢ false: Restricts to radio buttons or single-select dropdowns for one choice only

options.description: List of individual selectable options available in this field. Each option contains a value for data storage, display text for users, and optional metadata. The order of options in this list determines their display sequence in the form interface.

FormFieldPdfDto.description: Data Transfer Object for PDF field mapping information that connects form fields to specific locations and properties within PDF documents. Enables automatic population of PDF forms with data collected through web forms and precise positioning for form-to-PDF integration.

id.description: Unique identifier for the pdf field

text.description: Text content or label associated with the PDF field. Typically represents the field name, caption, or descriptive text as it appears in the PDF document.

fullName.description: Fully-qualified PDF field path as returned by iText's PdfAcroForm.getAllFormFields() map key â€” the address used to locate the underlying PDF xFA object. For hierarchical AcroForm / XFA layouts this is dot/bracket-separated (e.g. 'clients[0].form[0].name[0]'); for flat forms it is just the field name.

toolTipText.description: Tooltip text that appears when users hover over the PDF field. Provides additional guidance, context, or instructions for completing the field within the PDF.
toolTipText.example: Enter your full legal name as it appears on your identification documents

rectWidth.description: Width of the PDF field rectangle in points (1/72 inch). Defines the horizontal size of the input area within the PDF document layout.

rectHeight.description: Height of the PDF field rectangle in points (1/72 inch). Defines the vertical size of the input area within the PDF document layout.

rectX.description: X-coordinate position of the PDF field's left edge in points, measured from the left edge of the page. Provides precise horizontal positioning for the field within the PDF coordinate system.

rectY.description: Y-coordinate position of the PDF field's bottom edge in points, measured from the bottom of the page. PDF coordinate system has origin at bottom-left corner, unlike typical screen coordinate systems. Provides precise vertical positioning for the field.

pageNumber.description: Page number in the PDF document where this field appears. Page numbering starts from 1 for the first page. Used for multi-page PDF form coordination.

object.description: Serialized PDF field object containing the complete technical representation of the PDF field. Stores the full field definition including properties, constraints, formatting, and behavior information as extracted from or to be applied to the PDF document. Typically contains JSON or XML representation.

listOptionValue.description: Selected option value for list-based PDF fields such as dropdowns, radio buttons, or checkboxes. Represents the currently chosen option from the available choices defined in the PDF field. Used to maintain selection state when populating or reading from PDF forms.

optionRects.description: Per-widget rectangles, populated only for multi-widget fields (e.g. RADIO_GROUP). Empty for single-widget fields â€” in that case use the scalar rectX/rectY/rectWidth/rectHeight directly. When non-empty, the scalar fields hold the bounding box of all entries on the first option's page.

FormListOptionItemDto.description: Data Transfer Object representing an enhanced option item within a form list field that provides advanced value mapping capabilities. Supports enum integration, alternative value matching, and rich metadata for complex form scenarios where simple value-display pairs are insufficient.

id.description: Unique identifier for the list option item

value.description: Primary value of this option item used for data storage, form submission, and system processing. This is the core identifier that represents the selected choice within the application's data model.

display.description: Human-readable display text presented to users in the form interface. This is the label that users see when making their selection from the available options. Should be clear, descriptive, and user-friendly.

enumValue.description: Primary enum value associated with this option for type-safe programming integration. Links the option to a specific enum constant, enabling compile-time validation and improved code maintainability when working with predefined choice sets in the application.

textAssociated.description: Additional descriptive text associated with this option item for enhanced context. Can contain extended descriptions, help text, usage notes, administrative information, or any supplementary content that provides additional context about this choice. Often used for tooltips, explanatory text, or detailed option descriptions.
textAssociated.example: Federal republic in North America consisting of 50 states and federal districts

alternateEnumValues.description: List of alternative enum values that also match this option item for flexible data mapping. Provides compatibility for handling legacy data, migration scenarios, data import from external systems, or cases where multiple enum constants should map to the same user-visible option. Useful for maintaining backward compatibility during system evolution and enum refactoring.

FormSectionDto.description: Data Transfer Object for main form sections that provide the primary organizational structure within forms. Extends the base section functionality to include subsections, enabling hierarchical organization of form content with multiple levels of grouping for complex forms.

name.description: Name or title of the section displayed to users as a section header. Should clearly indicate the purpose or content of the grouped fields within this section. Used for form navigation and organizational structure.

description.description: Optional description providing additional context about the section's purpose or instructions. Can include guidance for completing the fields within this section or explanatory information about why the information is needed.
description.example: Please provide your basic personal details as they appear on official documents

fields.description: List of form fields that belong directly to this section. These fields are displayed as part of the section content and follow the section's visibility and interaction rules.

preamble.description: Introductory text displayed at the beginning of the section before any fields. Can contain HTML markup for rich formatting, detailed instructions, legal disclaimers, or any content that should appear at the section's start to provide context.

postScript.description: Concluding text displayed at the end of the section after all fields. Can contain HTML markup for rich formatting, additional instructions, warnings, summary information, or next-step guidance related to the completed section.

collapsible.description: Whether this section can be collapsed and expanded by users for better form navigation. When true, provides UI controls (typically expand/collapse icons) to hide or show section content. Useful for optional sections or improving form usability on long forms.

collapsedByDefault.description: Whether this section should be collapsed when the form initially loads. Only meaningful when collapsible is true. Useful for optional, advanced, or secondary sections that users can expand when needed without cluttering the initial form view.

collapsed.description: Current collapsed state of the section in the user interface. Tracks whether the section is currently expanded (false) or collapsed (true). Maintained for preserving user's interaction state during form sessions.

enabled.description: Whether this section and its fields are enabled for user interaction. When false, the entire section becomes disabled, preventing user input while still displaying content. Can be controlled by conditional logic or administrative settings.

required.description: Whether this entire section is required for successful form completion. When true, the form typically cannot be submitted unless all required fields within this section are properly completed. Used for section-level validation rules.

visible.description: Whether this section is currently visible to users in the form interface. Can be controlled by conditional logic rules to dynamically show or hide entire sections based on other field values or business rules for adaptive form behavior.

displayOrder.description: Display order for this section within its parent container. Used for drag-and-drop reordering in the form builder.

subSections.description: List of subsections contained within this main section for hierarchical organization. Enables nested grouping of form fields where main sections can be divided into smaller, more specific topic areas. Subsections inherit the organizational properties of their parent section while providing additional granular structure for complex data collection scenarios.

1-month rolling return percentage.

**Calculation:** Finds the valuation on or before (valuationDate - 1 month) and computes:
`((currentMV - baselineMV) / baselineMV) Ã— 100`

**Null when:** No historical valuation exists for the lookback period.

**Example:** If current MV is $1,050,000 and 1-month-ago MV was $1,000,000, return1m = 5.00%

return3m.description:
3-month rolling return percentage.

**Calculation:** Finds the valuation on or before (valuationDate - 3 months) and computes:
`((currentMV - baselineMV) / baselineMV) Ã— 100`

**Use case:** Quarterly performance assessment, comparing against benchmarks.

**Null when:** No historical valuation exists for the lookback period.

return6m.description:
6-month rolling return percentage.

**Calculation:** Finds the valuation on or before (valuationDate - 6 months) and computes:
`((currentMV - baselineMV) / baselineMV) Ã— 100`

**Use case:** Semi-annual performance review, trend analysis.

**Null when:** No historical valuation exists for the lookback period.

return1y.description:
1-year rolling return percentage.

**Calculation:** Finds the valuation on or before (valuationDate - 1 year) and computes:
`((currentMV - baselineMV) / baselineMV) Ã— 100`

**Use case:** Annual performance comparison, benchmark analysis, client reporting.

**Note:** This is a simple return (not annualized). The actual lookback may differ by a few days

AccountSnapshotDto.description:
Snapshot of an account in the household universe at valuation date.

Represents a financial account discovered via recursive ownership traversal
from the household through all members and intermediate entities.

**Discovery:** Uses recursive CTE to traverse Household â†’ Members â†’ LegalEntities â†’ Accounts

**Joint Accounts:** Appear once per owner with their ownership percentage (e.g., 50%/50%).
This enables accurate fractional ownership reporting for tax and estate planning.

**Ownership Percentages:**
- Individual accounts: 100% (single owner)
- Joint accounts: Split (e.g., 50%/50%)
- Entity-owned: 100% (LegalEntity owns the account)

**Hierarchy:** Household â†’ Members â†’ (optional) LegalEntities â†’ **Accounts** â†’ Portfolios â†’ Positions

accountName.description: Display name of the account, typically describing purpose or owner

accountNumber.description: External account number assigned by the custodian or institution

Account type classification indicating the tax treatment and structure.

**Common values:** BROKERAGE, INDIVIDUAL_RETIREMENT, ROTH_IRA, 401K,
TRUST, JOINT, CUSTODIAL, 529_PLAN, HSA, CORPORATE

accountCategory.description:
High-level account category for grouping and reporting.

**Common values:** TAXABLE, TAX_DEFERRED, TAX_EXEMPT, RETIREMENT, EDUCATION, HEALTH

ownerEntityType.description:
Entity type of the account owner.

- **INDIVIDUAL**: Account owned by a natural person (household member)
- **LEGAL_ENTITY**: Account owned by a trust, LLC, corporation, or other legal structure

ownerEntityId.description: Unique identifier of the owning entity (Individual or LegalEntity)

ownerName.description: Display name of the account owner

ownershipPct.description:
Ownership percentage of this account by the owner (0-100).

For individual accounts: typically 100%
For joint accounts: typically 50% per owner (account appears once per owner)

**Example:** John owns 50% of "Smith Joint Account" - ownershipPct = 50.00

marketValue.description:
Total current market value of all positions in the account.

**Calculation:** SUM(position.quantity Ã— position.currentPrice) for all positions.
Includes equities, fixed income, alternatives, and cash equivalents.

costBasis.description:
Total cost basis of all positions in the account.

**Calculation:** SUM(position.quantity Ã— position.averageCost) for all positions.
Used for calculating unrealized gains/losses and tax implications.

unrealizedPnl.description:
Total unrealized profit/loss for the account.

**Calculation:** marketValue - costBasis

Positive values indicate gains; negative values indicate losses.
Does not include realized gains from closed positions.

unrealizedPnlPct.description:
Unrealized P&L as a percentage of cost basis.

**Calculation:** (unrealizedPnl / costBasis) Ã— 100

Useful for comparing performance across accounts of different sizes.

cashBalance.description:
Cash and cash equivalents available in the account.

Includes money market funds, sweep accounts, and uninvested cash.
This is a subset of marketValue, not additional to it.

positionCount.description:
Total number of distinct positions (holdings) in the account.

Each unique security or instrument held counts as one position,
regardless of tax lots or purchase dates.

portfolioCount.description:
Number of portfolio sleeves (AccountPortfolio) within this account.

Portfolio sleeves allow an account to be divided into separately managed
segments, each potentially following a different model portfolio or strategy.

custodianName.description:
Name of the custodian or financial institution holding the account.

The custodian is responsible for safekeeping assets and executing transactions.

**Common custodians:** Charles Schwab, Fidelity, TD Ameritrade, Pershing,
Northern Trust, State Street, BNY Mellon

Daily valuation snapshot for a Household (family group) - top of the valuation hierarchy.

Aggregates the ownership-weighted net worth of all member entities (Individuals and LegalEntities).
Each member's contribution is weighted by the household's ownership percentage of that member.

**Position in Hierarchy:** Position â†’ Portfolio â†’ Account â†’ Owner â†’ **Household**

**Calculation:** totalMarketValue = SUM(member.netWorth Ã— memberOwnershipPct / 100)

return1m.description:
1-month rolling return percentage for the household.

**Calculation:** Finds the valuation on or before (valuationDate - 1 month) and computes:
`((currentMV - baselineMV) / baselineMV) Ã— 100`

**Scope:** Aggregates all household members' ownership-weighted values.

**Null when:** No historical valuation exists for the lookback period.

**Example:** If current household MV is $3,150,000 and 1-month-ago MV was $3,000,000, return1m = 5.00%

return3m.description:
3-month rolling return percentage for the household.

**Calculation:** Finds the valuation on or before (valuationDate - 3 months) and computes:
`((currentMV - baselineMV) / baselineMV) Ã— 100`

**Use case:** Quarterly family wealth review, comparing household performance against benchmarks.

**Null when:** No historical valuation exists for the lookback period.

return6m.description:
6-month rolling return percentage for the household.

**Calculation:** Finds the valuation on or before (valuationDate - 6 months) and computes:
`((currentMV - baselineMV) / baselineMV) Ã— 100`

**Use case:** Semi-annual family wealth review, trend analysis across the household.

**Null when:** No historical valuation exists for the lookback period.

return1y.description:
1-year rolling return percentage for the household.

**Calculation:** Finds the valuation on or before (valuationDate - 1 year) and computes:
`((currentMV - baselineMV) / baselineMV) Ã— 100`

**Use case:** Annual family wealth performance, year-over-year comparison, client reporting.

**Note:** This is a simple return (not annualized). The actual lookback may differ by a few days
due to weekends/holidays when the exact date has no valuation.

**Null when:** No historical valuation exists for the lookback period.

ownedAccounts.description:
All accounts in the household universe - the complete inventory of accounts owned
by household members or entities within the ownership hierarchy.

**Household Universe Traversal:**

Uses recursive ownership chain traversal to capture ALL accounts, including those
owned through intermediate Legal Entities (trusts, LLCs, holding companies).

```
Household â†’ Individual â†’ Account (direct ownership)
Household â†’ Individual â†’ LegalEntity (Trust) â†’ Account (nested ownership)
Household â†’ LegalEntity â†’ Account (entity-owned)
```

**Joint Account Handling:**

Joint accounts appear ONCE PER OWNER with their respective ownership percentage:
- "Smith Joint Brokerage" owned 50% by Robert Smith
- "Smith Joint Brokerage" owned 50% by Margaret Smith

This enables accurate reporting of fractional ownership and tax attribution.

**What's Included:**
- Accounts directly owned by household Individuals
- Accounts owned by household LegalEntities
- Accounts owned by LegalEntities that are themselves owned by household members
- Joint accounts (appearing once per co-owner with ownership %)

**What's NOT Included:**
- Accounts outside the household ownership hierarchy
- Accounts with terminated ownership relationships

**Use Cases:**
- Complete account inventory for household
- Joint account identification for tax planning
- Understanding nested ownership structures
- Consolidated reporting across all family accounts

FormConditionalRule.description: Conditional logic rule for dynamic form behavior based on field values

id.description: Unique identifier for the conditional rule

name.example: Show Address Fields When US Selected

logicalOperator.description: Logical operator to combine multiple conditions

conditions.description: List of conditions that must be met for this rule to trigger

conditionGrouping.description: Complex condition grouping expression (e.g., '1,2|3' means (condition1 AND condition2) OR condition3)

actions.description: List of actions to perform when rule conditions are met

active.description: Whether this rule is active

priority.description: Priority of this rule (higher numbers execute first)

FormDomain.description: Declares a domain entity type that a form pulls data from. Each domain has an alias used as the path prefix in field obtainValueFromPath expressions.

domainType.description: The entity type this domain maps to

alias.description: Path prefix used in obtainValueFromPath. For example, alias 'primaryOwner' means fields use paths like 'primaryOwner.firstName'.

displayName.description: Human-readable label for this domain instance

displayOrder.description: Display order within the form's domain list

FormField.description: Form field representing a single input element for data collection

id.description: Unique identifier for the form field

name.description: Label or display name of the field

associatedText.description: Additional text associated with the field
associatedText.example: Please enter your full legal name as it appears on your ID

displayOrder.description: Display order for this field within its parent section or subsection. Used for drag-and-drop reordering in the form builder.

page.description: Page number where this field appears

maxLength.description: Maximum length allowed for field input

minLength.description: Minimum length required for field input

placeholder.description: Placeholder text displayed in the field

helpText.description: Help text to guide users in filling out the field
helpText.example: Enter your name exactly as it appears on your government-issued ID

required.description: Whether the field is required to be filled out

validationPattern.description: Regular expression pattern for field validation

validationMessage.example: Name must contain only letters and spaces

obtainValueFromPath.description: Object path to obtain value from (e.g., 'customer.name' or 'order.amount')

list.description: List configuration for dropdown, radio, or checkbox fields

obtainedValue.description: Value obtained from the specified object path

visible.description: Whether the field is currently visible

cssClasses.description: CSS classes applied to the field for styling

pdfField.description: PDF-specific field information for form-to-PDF mapping

FormFieldList.description: Form field list configuration for dropdown, radio button, checkbox, and multi-select fields

id.description: Unique identifier for the form field list

allowMultiple.description: Whether multiple selections are allowed in this list. Set to true for checkboxes and multi-select dropdowns, false for radio buttons and single-select dropdowns.

options.description: Collection of selectable options with their values, display text, and associated metadata. These represent the choices available to users when interacting with the field.

optionsEnum.description: Name of the Java enum class associated with the list options. Used for type-safe option management and validation.

optionsValue.description: List of underlying data values for all options in this list. These are the actual values stored when an option is selected.

optionsDisplay.description: List of human-readable display text for all options in this list. These are the labels shown to users in the form interface.

optionsText.description: List of additional descriptive text associated with each option. Can contain help text, tooltips, or extended descriptions for each choice.

FormFieldPdf.description: PDF field mapping information that connects form fields to specific locations and properties within PDF documents. This enables automatic population of PDF forms with data collected through web forms.

id.description: Unique identifier for the PDF field mapping

text.description: Text content or label associated with the PDF field. This is typically the field name or caption as it appears in the PDF document.

fullName.description: Fully-qualified PDF field path as returned by iText's PdfAcroForm.getAllFormFields() map key â€” the address used to locate the underlying PDF xFA object. For hierarchical AcroForm / XFA layouts this is dot/bracket-separated (e.g. 'clients[0].form[0].name[0]'); for flat forms it is just the field name.

toolTipText.description: Tooltip text that appears when users hover over the PDF field. Provides additional guidance or context for filling out the field.
toolTipText.example: Enter your full legal name as it appears on your identification documents

rectWidth.description: Width of the PDF field rectangle in points (1/72 inch). Defines the horizontal size of the input area in the PDF.

rectHeight.description: Height of the PDF field rectangle in points (1/72 inch). Defines the vertical size of the input area in the PDF.

rectX.description: X-coordinate position of the PDF field's left edge in points, measured from the left edge of the page. Used for precise positioning of the field within the PDF layout.

rectY.description: Y-coordinate position of the PDF field's bottom edge in points, measured from the bottom of the page. Note: PDF coordinate system has origin at bottom-left, unlike typical screen coordinates.

pageNumber.description: Page number in the PDF document where this field appears. Page numbering starts from 1 for the first page.

listOptionValue.description: Selected option value for list-based PDF fields such as dropdowns, radio buttons, or checkboxes. This represents the currently chosen option from the available choices in the PDF field.

object.description: Serialized PDF field object containing the complete technical representation of the PDF field. This stores the full PDF field definition including all properties, constraints, and formatting information as extracted from or to be applied to the PDF document. Typically contains JSON or XML representation of the field's complete state.

optionRects.description: Per-widget rectangles, populated only for multi-widget fields (e.g. RADIO_GROUP). Empty for single-widget fields â€” in that case use the scalar rectX/rectY/rectWidth/rectHeight on this entity directly. When non-empty, the scalar fields hold the bounding box of all entries on the first option's page (suitable for scroll-target and the non-radio fallback overlay), and this list is the source of truth for per-option highlighting.

FormListOptionItem.description: Enhanced option item within a form list field that provides advanced value mapping capabilities. Supports enum integration, alternative value matching, and rich metadata for complex form scenarios where simple value-display pairs are insufficient.

id.description: Unique identifier for the form list option item

value.description: Primary value of this option item used for data storage and form submission. This is the core identifier that represents the selected choice in the system.

display.description: Human-readable display text presented to users in the form interface. This is the label that users see when making their selection from the available options.

enumValue.description: Primary enum value associated with this option for type-safe programming. Links the option to a specific enum constant, enabling compile-time validation and improved code maintainability when working with predefined choice sets.

alternateEnumValues.description: List of alternative enum values that also match this option item. Provides flexibility for handling legacy data, migration scenarios, or cases where multiple enum constants should map to the same user-visible option. Useful for maintaining backward compatibility during enum refactoring.

textAssociated.description: Additional descriptive text associated with this option item. Can contain extended descriptions, help text, usage notes, or any supplementary information that provides context about this choice. Often used for tooltips, explanatory text, or administrative notes.
textAssociated.example: Federal republic in North America consisting of 50 states and federal districts

FormSection.description: Main organizational section within a form that groups related fields and subsections. Provides the primary structural hierarchy for complex forms with multiple topic areas.

id.description: Unique identifier for the form section

name.description: Name or title of the section displayed to users. This serves as the section header and should clearly indicate the purpose or content of the grouped fields.

description.description: Optional description providing additional context about the section's purpose or instructions for completing the fields within it.
description.example: Please provide your basic personal details as they appear on official documents

fields.description: List of form fields that belong directly to this section. These fields are displayed as part of the section content.

preamble.description: Introductory text displayed at the beginning of the section. Can contain HTML markup for rich formatting, instructions, legal disclaimers, or any content that should appear before the section fields.

postScript.description: Concluding text displayed at the end of the section. Can contain HTML markup for rich formatting, additional instructions, warnings, or summary information related to the section.

collapsible.description: Whether this section can be collapsed/expanded by users. When true, provides UI controls to hide/show section content for better form navigation.

collapsedByDefault.description: Whether this section should be collapsed when the form initially loads. Only meaningful when collapsible is true. Useful for optional or advanced sections.

collapsed.description: Current collapsed state of the section. Tracks whether the section is currently expanded (false) or collapsed (true) in the UI.

required.description: Whether this entire section is required for form completion. When true, the form cannot be submitted unless this section is properly filled out.

visible.description: Whether this section is currently visible to users. Can be controlled by conditional logic rules to show/hide sections based on other field values.

displayOrder.description: Display order for this section within its parent container. Used for drag-and-drop reordering in the form builder.

readonly.description: Whether this section is in read-only mode. When true, all fields within the section cannot be edited by users.

subSections.description: List of subsections contained within this main section. Enables hierarchical organization of form content with nested groupings.

FormSectionSubSection.description: Subsection within a main form section that provides additional hierarchical organization. Allows for finer-grained grouping of related fields within larger section topics.

id.description: Unique identifier for the form section

name.description: Name or title of the section displayed to users. This serves as the section header and should clearly indicate the purpose or content of the grouped fields.

description.description: Optional description providing additional context about the section's purpose or instructions for completing the fields within it.
description.example: Please provide your basic personal details as they appear on official documents

fields.description: List of form fields that belong directly to this section. These fields are displayed as part of the section content.

preamble.description: Introductory text displayed at the beginning of the section. Can contain HTML markup for rich formatting, instructions, legal disclaimers, or any content that should appear before the section fields.

postScript.description: Concluding text displayed at the end of the section. Can contain HTML markup for rich formatting, additional instructions, warnings, or summary information related to the section.

collapsible.description: Whether this section can be collapsed/expanded by users. When true, provides UI controls to hide/show section content for better form navigation.

collapsedByDefault.description: Whether this section should be collapsed when the form initially loads. Only meaningful when collapsible is true. Useful for optional or advanced sections.

collapsed.description: Current collapsed state of the section. Tracks whether the section is currently expanded (false) or collapsed (true) in the UI.

required.description: Whether this entire section is required for form completion. When true, the form cannot be submitted unless this section is properly filled out.

visible.description: Whether this section is currently visible to users. Can be controlled by conditional logic rules to show/hide sections based on other field values.

displayOrder.description: Display order for this section within its parent container. Used for drag-and-drop reordering in the form builder.

readonly.description: Whether this section is in read-only mode. When true, all fields within the section cannot be edited by users.

PdfOptionRect.description: One PDF widget annotation's rectangle, used to highlight a single option of a multi-widget field such as RADIO_GROUP. Joined to FormListOptionItem.value via the 'value' field (widget appearance state).

value.description: Widget appearance state (e.g. 'Choice1', 'Yes'). Matches FormListOptionItem.value so the FE can join option metadata to its rectangle. Null only for the rare unnamed widget.

rectX.description: X-coordinate of the widget's left edge, in centimeters. Same units as FormFieldPdf scalar fields.

rectY.description: Y-coordinate of the widget's bottom edge, in centimeters. PDF coordinate origin is bottom-left.

rectWidth.description: Width of the widget's rectangle, in centimeters.

rectHeight.description: Height of the widget's rectangle, in centimeters.

pageNumber.description: 1-based PDF page number where this widget appears. May differ from FormFieldPdf.pageNumber for the rare multi-page radio group.

SupplementalAttributeCategory.description: Category for organizing supplemental attributes into logical groups

tenantId.description: Tenant this entity belongs to (for multi-tenant data isolation)

firmId.description: FirmTeam this entity belongs to within the tenant (for firm-level data filtering)

categoryKey.description: Unique key for the category. Must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores. Maximum 50 characters.

description.description: Detailed description of what this category represents
description.example: Attributes related to risk assessment and tolerance

active.description: Whether this category is active and available for use

ownershipType.description: Ownership type of the category: BUILT_IN (system-wide, visible to all tenants) or CUSTOM (tenant-specific, visible only to creating tenant)

SupplementalAttributeChoiceList.description: Reusable choice list for SELECT and MULTI_SELECT supplemental attributes. Defines a set of allowed values that can be selected.

tenantId.description: Tenant this entity belongs to (for multi-tenant data isolation)

firmId.description: FirmTeam this entity belongs to within the tenant (for firm-level data filtering)

id.description: Unique identifier for the choice list

key.description: Unique key for the choice list. Must start with a letter and contain only letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores.

label.description: Human-readable label for the choice list

description.description: Description of what this choice list represents
description.example: Available expense categories for fund management

ownershipType.description: Ownership type: BUILT_IN (system-wide, visible to all tenants) or CUSTOM (tenant-specific)

active.description: Whether this choice list is active and can be used

items.description: Items (allowed values) in this choice list

SupplementalAttributeChoiceListItem.description: A single selectable value within a choice list. Can have an optional display name that differs from the stored value.

id.description: Unique identifier for the choice list item

choiceList.description: The choice list this item belongs to

value.description: The actual value stored in the database when this choice is selected

displayName.description: Optional human-readable label shown to users. If not provided, the value itself is displayed.

displayOrder.description: Order in which to display this item in selection lists

active.description: Whether this choice is active and can be selected

SupplementalAttributeConfiguration.description: Configuration parameter for a supplemental attribute. Allows attributes to have multiple independent settings/dimensions, each with its own type, validation, and choices.

tenantId.description: Tenant this entity belongs to (for multi-tenant data isolation)

firmId.description: FirmTeam this entity belongs to within the tenant (for firm-level data filtering)

key.description: Unique key for this configuration within the attribute definition

description.description: Description of what this configuration controls

ownershipType.description: Ownership type: BUILT_IN (system-wide, immutable) or CUSTOM (tenant-specific, modifiable)

choiceList.description: Managed choice list (mutually exclusive with enumReferenceClassName and inlineChoices)

enumReferenceClassName.description: Fully qualified enum class name (BUILT_IN only, mutually exclusive with choiceList and inlineChoices)

inlineChoices.description: JSON array of simple choice values (mutually exclusive with choiceList and enumReferenceClassName)

required.description: Whether a value must be provided for this configuration

pattern.description: Regex pattern for validation (STRING, TEXT, URL, EMAIL, PHONE types)

decimalPlaces.description: Number of decimal places (NUMBER, MONEY, PERCENT types)

displayOrder.description: Order to display this configuration in UI

active.description: Whether this configuration is active

helpText.description: Help text to display in UI (tooltip, hint)

SupplementalAttributeConfigurationValue.description: Actual value selected for a configuration parameter on a specific attribute value. Stores configuration choices like time_point=end_date, currency=EUR, adjusted=true.

tenantId.description: Tenant this entity belongs to (for multi-tenant data isolation)

firmId.description: FirmTeam this entity belongs to within the tenant (for firm-level data filtering)

attributeValue.description: The attribute value this configuration value belongs to

configuration.description: The configuration this is a value for

value.description: The configuration value. Interpreted based on configuration type. For BOOLEAN: 'true'/'false'. For SELECT: selected value. For MULTI_SELECT: comma-separated values.

valueStart.description: Start datetime for TIME_PERIOD configuration types

valueEnd.description: End datetime for TIME_PERIOD configuration types

SupplementalAttributeDefinition.description: Attribute definition (schema/template) that defines what supplemental attributes are available for tenants to use on entities. This is the 'registration' layer - it defines WHAT can exist, not the actual values.

tenantId.description: Tenant this entity belongs to (for multi-tenant data isolation)

firmId.description: FirmTeam this entity belongs to within the tenant (for firm-level data filtering)

id.description: Unique identifier for the attribute definition

key.description: Unique key for the attribute definition. Must start with a letter, number, or underscore and contain only letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores. Supports Addepar attribute IDs (e.g., _custom_verita_adm_status_1999622, 401k).

type.description: Data type of the attribute value

description.description: Description of what this attribute represents
description.example: Investment risk score from 0 to 100

category.description: Category this attribute belongs to

required.description: Whether this attribute is required when used

hidden.description: Whether this attribute is hidden from normal display

rollUpMethodology.description: Methodology for rolling up/aggregating this attribute across multiple entities

displayOrder.description: Order in which to display this attribute

ownershipType.description: Ownership type: BUILT_IN (system-wide, visible to all tenants) or CUSTOM (tenant-specific)

decimalPlacesDisplayed.description: Number of decimal places to display for NUMBER, PERCENT, and MONEY types

applicableTo.description: Entity types this attribute can be applied to (Fund, Account, Order, etc.)

items.description: Types of entities that can have supplemental attributes attached

active.description: Whether this attribute definition is active and can be used

sourceMetadata.description: Source system metadata stored as JSON. For Addepar synced attributes, contains spec_id, usage array, output_type, created_at, modified_at, etc.

configurations.description: Configurations for this attribute. Each configuration defines an independent setting/dimension with its own type, validation, and choice source. Configurations are reusable across multiple definitions.

SupplementalAttributeValue.description: Supplemental attribute value instance attached to a specific entity. References a SupplementalAttributeDefinition and stores the actual value conforming to the definition's type.

tenantId.description: Tenant this entity belongs to (for multi-tenant data isolation)

firmId.description: FirmTeam this entity belongs to within the tenant (for firm-level data filtering)

id.description: Unique identifier for this attribute value instance

definition.description: Reference to the attribute definition (schema/template) that defines this attribute's type, constraints, and validation rules. This is a foreign key to SupplementalAttributeDefinition.

attrValue.description: The actual value stored as a string. Must conform to the definition's attrType. For NUMBER: '75', for BOOLEAN: 'true'/'false', for DATE: 'yyyy-MM-dd', etc. For TIME_PERIOD, use attrValueStart and attrValueEnd instead.

attrValueStart.description: Start datetime for TIME_PERIOD type attributes. Used in conjunction with attrValueEnd to define a date/time range. Only populated when definition.type is TIME_PERIOD.

attrValueEnd.description: End datetime for TIME_PERIOD type attributes. Used in conjunction with attrValueStart to define a date/time range. Only populated when definition.type is TIME_PERIOD.

entityType.description: The type of entity this attribute value is attached to (FUND, ACCOUNT, ORDER, DOCUMENT, etc.). Must be one of the types defined in the definition's applicableTo set, validated automatically on save.

entityId.description: UUID of the specific entity instance this attribute value is attached to. Combined with entityType, uniquely identifies which entity owns this value.

configurationValues.description: Configuration values selected for this attribute value. Each configuration value provides a specific setting (e.g., time_point=end_date, currency=EUR).

MoveSubSectionRequest.description: Request to move or reorder a subsection within or between parent sections. Set sourceSectionId == targetSectionId for a simple reorder within the same section. Set them to different values to move the subsection to a new parent section. All affected displayOrder values are recalculated after the move.

subSectionId.description: Database ID of the subsection to move. Must exist as a child of the source section.

sourceSectionId.description: Database ID of the section that currently contains the subsection. The subsection must be a direct child of this section.

targetSectionId.description: Database ID of the section to move the subsection into. Use the same value as sourceSectionId for a reorder within the same section, or a different section ID to move the subsection to a new parent.

targetIndex.description: 0-based target position within the target section's subsection list. Index 0 places the subsection first; an index >= the subsection count places it last (clamped).

MoveSectionRequest.description: Request to reorder a top-level section within a form. The section is removed from its current position and inserted at the specified targetIndex. All sibling sections have their displayOrder recalculated after the move.

sectionId.description: Database ID of the section to move. Must belong to the form specified in the URL path.

targetIndex.description: 0-based target position in the form's section list. Index 0 places the section first; an index equal to or greater than the section count places it last (clamped).

MoveFieldRequest.description: Request to move or reorder a field within or between sections and subsections. Fields can exist at the section level (sourceSubSectionId/targetSubSectionId = null) or at the subsection level (provide the subsection ID). Supports reordering within the same container as well as cross-container moves. All affected displayOrder values are recalculated.

fieldId.description: Database ID of the field to move. Must exist within the source container (section or subsection) identified by the source IDs.

sourceSectionId.description: Database ID of the section that currently contains the field. If the field is in a subsection, this is the parent section of that subsection.

sourceSubSectionId.description: Database ID of the subsection the field is currently in. Set to null if the field is at the section level (directly under a section, not in a subsection).

targetSectionId.description: Database ID of the section to move the field to. If moving into a subsection, this is the parent section of the target subsection.

targetSubSectionId.description: Database ID of the subsection to move the field into. Set to null to place the field at the section level (directly under the target section).

targetIndex.description: 0-based target position within the target container's field list. Index 0 places the field first; an index >= the field count places it last (clamped).

FormParseJobResponse.description: Response from async form parsing job submission

jobId.description: Unique job identifier (UUID). Use this to poll for status via GET /jobs/{jobId} and to cleanup via DELETE /jobs/{jobId}.

status.description: Initial job status. Always 'queued' when the job is first created.

FillFormRequest.description: Request body for filling a form from domain entity instances

domainBindings.description: Map of domain alias to entity UUID. Keys must match the aliases declared in the form's domains list.

ConnectionTestResultDto.description: Result of testing a connection to an external integration provider

provider.description: The integration provider that was tested

requestUrl.description: The full URL that was requested

requestMethod.description: The HTTP method used for the test

requestHeaders.description: Request headers that were sent (secrets are masked)

httpStatusCode.description: HTTP status code returned by the provider

responseHeaders.description: Response headers returned by the provider

errorMessage.description: Error message if the connection test failed

FirmFileSyncFilterPatternReorderDto.description: Reorder request for the firm's file sync filter pattern catalog.

patternIds.description: Every non-deleted pattern id for the firm, in the desired new order. Server assigns position 1 to the first id, 2 to the second, etc.

errors.description: Detailed error messages if validation failed

TransferOwnershipRequestDto.description: Request to transfer ownership from one entity to another

existingRelationshipId.description: The ID of the existing ownership relationship to transfer from

newOwnerType.description: The entity type of the new owner

newOwnerId.description: The ID of the new owner

percentageToTransfer.description: The percentage of ownership to transfer to the new owner. If this equals the original owner's percentage, it's a full transfer. If less, the original owner retains the remainder.

effectiveDate.description: The effective date of the transfer. Defaults to today if not provided.

newOwnerRole.description: Role for the new owner (e.g., 'Owner', 'Joint Owner')

notes.description: Notes about the transfer (e.g., 'Gift to daughter', 'Sale')

message.description: Detailed message about the test result

documentType.description: Primary document type (INDIVIDUAL, ACCOUNT, FUND, etc.)

documentSubType.description: Document subtype as string (PASSPORT, DRIVERS_LICENSE, etc.)

extractedData.description: Extracted structured data from document (OCR, field extraction, etc.)

metadata.description: Additional document metadata (page count, file size, language, etc.)

processingToken.description: Processing token for bypassing re-processing. Include this when uploading the document.

processingToken.description: Processing token for all documents (bypasses re-processing)

documentType.description: Document type classification

documentSubType.description: Document subtype

extractedData.description: Extracted data from parser (typed DTO structure)

extractedText.description: Raw extracted text from document (OCR output)

accountDocumentType.description: Types of documents specific to account verification, identification, and legal authorization
